summary: Independent underwriting pass focused on the highest-information-value unresolved item, XTND. Current evidence confirms a legitimate newly public robotics/defense challenger and proves material dilution complexity, but it does not yet support a normalized post-close fully diluted denominator or a clean cash-runway view. XTND therefore remains in discovery only and must not receive admission, Earth Score, Opportunity Score or rank treatment yet. The active 250 otherwise remain unchanged by this lane.

materialFindings.finding: XTND remains explicitly outside the active universe and admission-ineligible in the canonical discovery pool pending full methodology review; the discovery record cites the Sept. 3, 2026 merger close and NYSE listing plus SEC filings.

Primary SEC registration evidence shows that the merger structure contemplated up to 316,167,575 common shares plus pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 24,873,730 shares and the corresponding underlying shares. This demonstrates large dilution capacity/complexity but is a registration ceiling, not proof of the exact post-close outstanding or fully diluted share count.

The SEC filing-fee exhibit specifically identifies 24,873,730 pre-funded warrants and states that an additional 24,160,775 common shares were added to the registration statement. These instruments must be reconciled against actual conversion/issuance mechanics before a per-share valuation denominator can be trusted.

The post-merger issuer is confirmed as Xtend AI Robotics, Inc., ticker XTND, NYSE, with the merger effective Sept. 3, 2026. Entity identity is therefore not the blocker; capitalization normalization and operating runway are.

A secondary summary of the Sept. 3 current report describes H1 2026 revenue growth, large operating cash use, cash on hand, backlog, an undrawn credit facility and earnout shares. Because Earth requires primary evidence for decision-critical values, those figures are useful research targets but are not promoted here as canonical underwriting facts until reconciled to the exact SEC filing tables and post-close share mechanics.

proposedCanonicalChanges.proposal: Keep XTND admissionEligible=false and prohibit score/rank/opportunity treatment until the exact post-close common-share count, pre-funded warrants, earnout shares, equity-plan/S-8 overhang, net cash/debt and normalized operating runway are reconciled from primary filings without double counting.

contradictions.issue: Public-market quote pages can show a small apparent market capitalization based on listed/free-trading shares while merger registration documents contemplate hundreds of millions of common/pre-funded-warrant shares. Until the denominator is normalized, apparent market cap is not decision-grade valuation evidence.

unknowns.unknown: Exact post-close basic common shares outstanding and the subset of registered shares actually issued remain unreconciled in this pass.

Exact pre-funded-warrant count outstanding after close, exercise mechanics, and whether any registered warrant-related shares would be double-counted in a naive fully diluted denominator remain unresolved.

Normalized cash runway after the merger, including net proceeds, current unrestricted cash, debt/credit-facility availability and a sustainable operating-cash-burn estimate, remains unresolved from primary tables.
Earnout and equity-plan dilution percentages on a fully reconciled post-close denominator remain unresolved.

peerRequests.request: Preserve exact SEC accession/document provenance when the post-close capitalization table is reconstructed; prevent registration capacity, outstanding shares and warrant-underlying shares from being conflated.
Stress-test XTND earnout, control concentration, financing dependence and any promotional-contract/backlog claims once the primary post-close capitalization and liquidity bridge is complete.
Do not use quote-page market cap or per-share valuation until underwriting supplies a reconciled post-close diluted denominator and net-cash/runway bridge.

accuracyDebates.topic: Should registered merger share capacity be treated as fully diluted shares outstanding?
accuracyDebates.position: No. Registration capacity proves potential issuance/dilution structure, not the exact economic denominator. Earth should remain conservative until actual post-close issuance, warrants, earnouts and plan overhang are reconciled.

blockingIssues.issue: XTND cannot be admitted or scored until capital structure and runway are normalized from primary post-close evidence.

directivesReviewed.result: Primary SEC evidence independently confirms substantial registered common/pre-funded-warrant capacity and the need for denominator reconciliation. Closure criteria are not yet met because exact post-close basic/fully diluted shares and normalized cash runway remain unresolved.
